codexBrief.goal: Build a premium modern restaurant website for Haseki Restaurant, inspired by phocafe.co.uk, but with its own Japanese-Vietnamese identity.
codexBrief.importantInstruction: Do not copy phocafe.co.uk exactly. Use it only as inspiration for warm colors, strong food photography, clean menu UX, mobile-first layout and friendly Asian restaurant feeling.
mainRequirements: Use warm Asian bistro design, not full black luxury design.
Use provided images only as representative images for menu categories.
Do not require one image per dish.
Use category tabs and search for menu.
Use sticky bottom action buttons on mobile: Anrufen, Route, Speisekarte.
Use reusable components and clean code.

design.styleDescription: Warm, friendly, visual, modern Japanese-Vietnamese restaurant style. Premium but not too dark or too formal.
design.inspiration: Pho Cafe UK style: warm colors, large food images, friendly Vietnamese/Asian atmosphere, strong mobile UX.
avoid: Do not use full black background on the whole website.
Do not make it look too corporate.
Do not make it too Michelin fine-dining.
Do not overload with too many animations.
effects: Category tabs horizontal scroll on mobile

siteStructure.description: Logo left, navigation links, reservation/call button, sticky with blur on scroll.
Large hero section using sushi platter image. Warm overlay, large headline, two CTA buttons.

developerNotes.menuAccuracy: The full printed menu contains more items and exact prices. This JSON provides the website structure, category mapping, image mapping and known dish/category names from the provided menu images. Exact prices/descriptions should be completed from the original menu source if needed.
recommendedImplementation: Render category representative image at top of each category section.
For items with missing price, hide price or show nothing until price is filled.
Use category fallback image if item image is missing.
Do not break the page if items array is empty; show the category card anyway.
